comment.body: Engineering should investigate why no metrics are appearing in dashboards for the observability beta customer after the recent upgrade. Check for possible issues with data ingestion, dashboard integrations, and any changes made during the upgrade process. Customer noted this started after opting into the beta and is blocked for an upcoming launch review.

Thank you for reporting this issue. Our engineering team is actively investigating the problem with dashboards showing no metrics since your upgrade to the observability beta. We understand the urgency ahead of your launch review and will keep you updated as soon as we have more information.

reply:
I triaged the open inbox according to the team plan:

- The observability-beta incident ("dashboards show no metrics since upgrade") was handled first.
    - I set its priority to urgent and added the "obs-beta" tag, keeping prior tags.
    - I left a private note for engineering outlining what should be investigated.
    - I then posted a public acknowledgment to the customer, confirming the issue is being investigated.

All protected P0 non-beta security incidents and unrelated tickets were left unchanged as required. No actions remain unfinished.
